reader_summary.overview: Before we get started, if you're into capital efficiency in smarter portfolio construction, mark your calendar. The second annual return stacking symposium is coming to Chicago on October 28, 2026, headlined by Cliff Asnes, founder and CIO of AQR. It's a full day of conversations on how to stack returns dreams, put your capital to work more efficiently, and rethink the way you build portfolios.

thesis: The episode argues that portable alpha solves the funding problem by allowing investors to access long short diversifiers without selling their underlying equity or bond exposure, thereby avoiding the underweighting in traditional beta that caused significant losses in the last decade. This approach is distinguished from simple leverage because it focuses on the source of funding for the strategy rather than just the use of derivatives.
